name: Source checkout
responsibility: Which archboard checkout this process runs and the port of its server: 3000 for the main checkout, a hash of the path for a worktree; hands a command to the bin/archboard of the checkout it stands in
description: The main checkout has a .git directory; a linked worktree has a .git file and takes 10000 + sha256(root path) mod 10000. The default server URL, the --url default and the server's own port all come from here. The hand-off follows the working directory, not -C, and does not happen when the environment sets ARCHBOARD_URL: the URL already names the server, and every Codex thread sets it, so a workhorse in another archboard checkout runs the server's own source (ADR 0050). It waits for the other checkout's command, passes SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGHUP on to it and answers with its exit status, and it refuses a checkout with no node_modules, naming the bun install to run there.
